method: FM3_MD_PRESETS.py --run: per Type, edit-buffer load of the default preset (7F 00) + fn=0x1F read (must equal the default), the user chooses the Type on channel A (front panel or FM3-Edit, no Save), fn=0x1F read saved. The script never stores and never sets.

summary.meaning: Every Multi Delay Type is now a measured full-channel image from the device-default start. Choosing a Type changed only channel A; the device kept channels B..D. These images are what a Type selection produces from the default; the generator can apply one as a full-channel template (all 121 words), not as a selector write.

notMeasured: the fill from a non-default start (images are from the device default)
whether front panel and FM3-Edit fills differ (the Pealing Bells repeat matched T27 exactly)
